homeFaqs.question: What is Go Banjara?
homeFaqs.answer: Go Banjara is a slow-travel community and premium outdoor boutique brand. We craft immersive road trips, treks, and beach escapes, alongside durable, highly styled travel gear like waterproof backpacks, passport covers, iron-on badges, and premium journals.

homeFaqs.question: How do I book a travel package?
homeFaqs.answer: Browse our curated packages under the Travel section. Choose your travel date and group size, then click 'Book Now' to submit an inquiry. Our community guides will reach out within 24 hours to confirm your details and add the package to your cart.

homeFaqs.question: What is your gear return policy?
homeFaqs.answer: We offer a 15-day hassle-free return window for all boutique gear and apparel in unused, original packaging. All products also carry a 6-month warranty against manufacturing defects.

homeFaqs.question: Do you support local communities?
homeFaqs.answer: Yes, 85% of your travel package expenses go directly to supporting local homestays, native guides, remote monasteries, and local micro-economies. Our gear is also sourced responsibly from local artisans.

homeFaqs.question: What materials are the badges made from?
homeFaqs.answer: Zinc alloy with glossy enamel fill. Lightweight, durable, and safe to pin on bags, jackets, or backpacks without damaging fabric.

cms.homeBonjoText1: Go Banjara was born from a frustration travel in India had become a checklist. Same cafés, same photo spots, same three-day Goa loop. We wanted something slower, closer to the ground, and honest about the places it visited.
cms.homeBonjoText2: So we built a hybrid platform: curated small-group journeys, a shop of honest gear made by artisans we know by name, and a community of travelers who share notes from the road instead of just photos.
cms.homeBonjoText3: Travel. Lifestyle. Community. Commerce. Under one roof because we don't think they were ever supposed to live apart.

customPages.title: Privacy Policy
customPages.metaDescription: Read how Go Banjara protects and manages your personal information and trip data.
customPages.content:
# Privacy Policy

Welcome to **Go Banjara Experiences Pvt. Ltd.** ("Go Banjara", "we", "us", or "our"). We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.

### 1. Information We Collect
We collect personal information that you voluntarily provide to us when registering an account, booking a travel package, or purchasing products from our store:
- **Personal Identification Details**: Name, email address, mobile number, emergency contact details.
- **Payment Information**: Processed securely via PCI-DSS compliant gateways like Razorpay. We do not store raw card numbers or CVVs on our servers.
- **Trip Preferences**: Dietary restrictions, medical conditions disclosed for trekking safety, passport details for flight/permit bookings.

### 2. How We Use Your Information
- To fulfill and manage your travel bookings, hotel vouchers, and product deliveries.
- To send instant WhatsApp/Email booking confirmations, invoice receipts, and trip itineraries.
- To improve our website performance, customer support, and tailored travel recommendations.

### 3. Data Protection & Security
We implement SSL encryption, role-based database access, and regular security audits to prevent unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure of your data.

### 4. Contact Us
For any privacy concerns or data access requests, please email us at **privacy@gobanjara.com**.

customPages.title: Terms & Conditions
customPages.metaDescription: Terms of service, trip cancellation guidelines, and store policies for Go Banjara.
customPages.content:
# Terms & Conditions

Please read these Terms & Conditions carefully before booking any tour packages or purchasing merchandise on Go Banjara.

### 1. Booking & Payments
- A minimum 30% advance payment is required to confirm your seat on any group trip or package.
- The remaining balance must be cleared 7 days prior to departure date.

### 2. Cancellation & Refund Policy
- **30+ days prior to departure**: 90% refund of total trip cost.
- **15 to 29 days prior**: 50% refund.
- **0 to 14 days prior**: No refund due to upfront hotel & transport reservations.
- Store products can be returned or exchanged within 7 days of delivery in unused condition with tags intact.

### 3. Code of Conduct on Trips
Go Banjara promotes friendly, inclusive, and eco-responsible travel. Zero tolerance is maintained for harassment, illegal drug use, or damage to natural ecosystems.

customPages.title: Frequently Asked Questions
customPages.metaDescription: Find answers to popular questions about trip bookings, gear shipping, and cancellation rules.
customPages.content:
# Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Q1: Are solo travelers welcome on group trips?
**Yes!** Over 60% of Go Banjara wanderers travel solo. Our group trips are designed to foster warm friendships and memorable group bonding.

### Q2: What is included in the travel package cost?
Each package clearly lists inclusions such as accommodation, meals, internal transport, certified trip leads, and sightseeing passes. Check the specific package page for detailed lists.

### Q3: How long does merchandise delivery take?
Orders are dispatched within 24 hours. Standard shipping across India takes 3 to 5 business days.

### Q4: How do I link merchandise perks to my trip?
When booking select premium packages, complimentary gear (like our Nomad Keychain or Badge) will be automatically added to your booking confirmation!

packages.name: Spiti Valley Traverse
packages.description: Explore high altitude Spiti villages, post cards from Hikkim, and camp under the stars at Chandratal.
highlights: Drive through Atal Tunnel & Kunzum Pass
Visit the ancient Key & Dhankar monasteries
Chandratal lake camping and stargazing
Explore Langza, Hikkim & Komik villages
exclusions: Flights or travel expenses to Manali
Mandatory travel insurance (highly recommended)
Lunch meals, personal snacks, and bottled mineral water
Tips for guides, driver, hotel staff, and camel handlers
Any personal expenses, souvenir shopping, or laundry services
packingList: Heavy fleece jackets, windbreaker, and thermal base layers
Sturdy water-resistant hiking boots with good grip
Polarized sunglasses and high SPF sunscreen
Reusable thermos water bottle for hot water
High capacity power bank (extreme cold drains batteries)

faqs.q: What standard are the accommodations? (Hotels, homestays, tents)
faqs.a: We use premium boutique hotels in Kaza, and high-quality lakeside dome tents with attached bathrooms at Chandratal.

faqs.q: Is AMS (Altitude Mountain Sickness) a concern?
faqs.a: Yes, because Spiti is at 3,800m. We include acclimatization rest on Day 1 and Day 2. Our vehicles carry medical oxygen cylinders.

reviews.name: Rohan Malhotra
reviews.comment: “An absolute dream road trip! Driving through Kunzum Pass was thrilling, and the view of Chandratal at sunset is something I will never forget. Vikram Aditya was the perfect guide.”

guide.name: Vikram Aditya
guide.bio: Vikram is a native Himalayan guide with 12+ years of experience leading high-altitude road trips across Himachal and Ladakh.

itinerary.title: Manali → Kaza via Atal Tunnel
itinerary.offering: Drive through the Atal Tunnel at 3,000m and emerge into the cold desert. Afternoon arrival in Kaza. Acclimatization walk, orientation dinner.
itinerary.insiderTip: Take it extremely slow today to help your body adapt to the sudden high altitude of Kaza.

itinerary.title: Kaza → Key Monastery → Kibber
itinerary.offering: Arrive at Srinagar airport. Meet our team and transfer to a traditional Houseboat on Dal Lake. Afternoon shikara ride and trip briefing in the evening.
itinerary.insiderTip: Try the local butter tea in Kibber; it is great for keeping warm in the high altitudes.

itinerary.title: Kibber → Hikkim → Komik → Langza
itinerary.offering: Arrive at Srinagar airport. Meet our team and transfer to a traditional Houseboat on Dal Lake. Afternoon shikara ride and trip briefing in the evening.
activities: Send a letter from the highest post office
itinerary.insiderTip: Look for marine fossils in Langza, but do not take them home as they are protected.

itinerary.title: Langza → Pin Valley National Park
itinerary.offering: Drive to Pin Valley National Park, visiting Mudh village and the ancient cliffside Dhankar Monastery.
itinerary.insiderTip: The views of the confluence of Spiti and Pin rivers near Dhankar are spectacular.

itinerary.title: Kaza to Chandratal Lake
itinerary.offering: Drive to the breathtaking crescent-shaped Chandratal Lake. Stargaze under clear Himalayan skies at the lakeside campsite.
itinerary.insiderTip: Keep all warm layers handy as temperatures at Chandratal can drop below freezing even in summer.

itinerary.title: Chandratal Lake to Manali
itinerary.offering: Drive back to Manali via Kunzum Pass and Atal Tunnel. Departure and trip ends by evening.
itinerary.insiderTip: Leave early from Chandratal to avoid traffic near the Atal Tunnel.

packages.name: Gulmarg Skiing
packages.description: Ascend Asia's highest cable car to ski Apharwat Peak with expert coaching and cozy chalets.
highlights: Certified ski instruction on pristine powder slopes
Phase 1 & 2 Gondola tickets to Apharwat Peak summit
Apres-ski steam therapy, sauna & traditional Wazwan feast
exclusions: Flights or travel expenses to Srinagar
Ski gear insurance against damage
Lunch meals and premium beverages
Tips for ski coaches, guides, and hotel staff
Personal shopping and laundry services
packingList: Fleece jackets, heavy winter coats, and thermal base layers
Waterproof ski trousers and snow gloves

faqs.q: Is ski coaching included for beginners?
faqs.a: Yes! We include 2 days of certified group ski instruction at the Gulmarg Ski slopes, which covers all basics and safety guidelines.
Yes, tickets for both phases are included in your package. Please keep your physical ID cards ready at the ticket counters.

reviews.name: Aditya Vardhan
reviews.comment: “Go Banjāra nailed the itinerary. The blend of adventure skiing, Gondola tickets, and the traditional Wazwan feast made it unforgettable.”

guide.name: Vikram Aditya
guide.bio: Vikram coordinates high-altitude adventures and skiing excursions across Kashmir.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Snowy Gulmarg Pass Drive
itinerary.offering: Private transfer in a 4x4 SUV equipped with mountain snow chains, check-in to a heated alpine chalet, and local ski gear selection and fitting session.
itinerary.insiderTip: Let the ski boots sit in the heated room overnight to make them easier to slip on tomorrow morning.

itinerary.title: First Skiing Lesson & Slope Training
itinerary.offering: High-end ski equipment rental (skis, boots, poles), private certified ski instructor for 4 hours, and beginner drag-lift passes.
activities: Basic balancing and snow walking training
itinerary.insiderTip: Do not lean backward when skiing downhill; lean forward over your shins to maintain control.

itinerary.title: Gondola Ride to Kongdori Valley (Phase 1)
itinerary.offering: Phase 1 Gondola ticket, intermediate ski guide, warm packed coffee thermos, and mountain slope safety briefing.
itinerary.insiderTip: Keep your ticket card safe in a sleeve; you need it scanned at multiple gates.

itinerary.title: Apharwat Peak Summit Gondola (Phase 2)
itinerary.offering: Ride the second phase of the Gondola to Apharwat Peak at nearly 4,000 meters. Explore the majestic frozen ridge overlooking the line of control.
itinerary.insiderTip: Due to the thin air at Apharwat Peak, walk slowly and take small sips of water regularly.

itinerary.title: Free Exploration & Snowshoe Trek
itinerary.offering: Spend the day at leisure. Join our optional guided snowshoe trek to Strawberry Valley or visit the local heritage shrine at Baba Reshi.
itinerary.insiderTip: Try the traditional Kashmiri Harrisa dish for breakfast at a local cafe to stay warm all day.

itinerary.title: Return to Srinagar & Houseboat Stays
itinerary.offering: Drive back to Srinagar and check in to a traditional hand-carved cedar houseboat. Relax with evening Shikara rides and a traditional Wazwan feast.
itinerary.insiderTip: The sunset colors reflecting off the waters of Dal Lake are a photographer's paradise.

itinerary.title: Airport Departure Transfer
itinerary.offering: After a cozy breakfast, transfer to Srinagar Airport for your return flight home, loaded with memories of snow-laden slopes.
itinerary.insiderTip: Security checks at Srinagar airport are rigorous. Make sure to arrive at least 3 hours before your flight.

packages.name: Kerala Couple Spl
packages.description: A curated couple & family getaway exploring Munnar hills, Periyar wildlife, and Alleppey backwaters.
highlights: Private AC Sedan transport with friendly driver
Premium hotel stays in Munnar & Thekkady
Houseboat Stay with all meals in Alleppey backwaters
Spice plantation guided walk
exclusions: Flights or train tickets to Kochi
Entrance tickets to monuments or national parks
Lunch meals, personal water, and drinks
Tips for driver and hotel workers
Optional activities (boating, elephant rides)

faqs.q: Is the houseboat stay private or shared?
faqs.a: The houseboat stay is 100% private for your family or couple booking, including a dedicated chef and captain.

faqs.q: What type of food is served on the houseboat?
faqs.a: Traditional Kerala meals (breakfast, lunch, and dinner) are cooked fresh on-board by your private chef. Vegetarian options are available upon request.

reviews.name: Vipin Das
reviews.comment: “Unbelievable trip! Munnar was misty and cool, and the backwaters in Alleppey were serene. The private driver was extremely polite and drove safely.”

guide.name: Anand Nair
guide.bio: Anand is a seasoned Kerala travel director who knows every scenic viewpoint, tea shop, and local story across Munnar, Alleppey, and Thekkady.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kochi & Drive to Munnar Hills
itinerary.offering: Pick up from Kochi airport or station. Travel by private sedan up the winding Munnar hills, passing beautiful spice valleys and the spectacular Cheeyappara waterfalls.
itinerary.insiderTip: Keep a light jacket handy; temperature drops noticeably once you reach the altitude of Munnar.

itinerary.title: Munnar Tea Plantations & Eravikulam National Park
itinerary.offering: Spend the day sightseeing in Munnar. Spot the rare Nilgiri Tahr at Eravikulam, take beautiful photos at Mattupetty Dam, and enjoy the natural echo at Echo Point.
itinerary.insiderTip: Book Eravikulam tickets online to skip the long entry queues.

itinerary.title: Travel to Thekkady & Spice Gardens Guided Tour
itinerary.offering: Drive to Thekkady, the spice center of Kerala. Take a guided walk through lush plantations of green cardamom, black pepper, and cinnamon, followed by an evening wildlife boat safari.
itinerary.insiderTip: Buy authentic vanilla and cardamom directly from the farming cooperative shops in Thekkady.

itinerary.title: Check-in to Private Alleppey Houseboat
itinerary.offering: Transfer to Alleppey. Board your luxury private wood-and-bamboo houseboat. Sail along palm-fringed lagoons while your personal chef prepares a classic lunch and dinner.
itinerary.insiderTip: Request the chef to cook local Pearl Spot fish (Karimeen Pollichathu) for dinner—it is prepared in banana leaves and is delicious.

itinerary.title: Houseboat Check-out & Kochi Departure
itinerary.offering: Enjoy breakfast on board the houseboat. Disembark and drive back to Kochi. Take a brief heritage tour of Fort Kochi before transferring to the airport.
itinerary.insiderTip: Arrive at the fishing nets around noon to watch the fishermen haul in their catch.

packages.name: Kerala Classic Tour
packages.description: Classic 3-night private getaway covering Munnar hills and Alleppey houseboats.
highlights: Private transport in AC sedan with local driver
Munnar tea garden sightseeing and mist valleys
Alleppey private houseboat stay with onboard dining
exclusions: Flights or train tickets
National park entry and activity fees
Lunch meals and premium beverages
Tips for driver and hotel workers
Souvenirs and personal laundry

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for senior citizens?
faqs.a: Yes! It is a private, relaxed trip with minimal walking and direct door-to-door vehicle transfers, making it very comfortable for seniors.

reviews.name: Manoj Kumar
reviews.comment: “Extremely cozy and pleasant. We had a great time in Munnar and the houseboat was very clean. Driver was friendly.”

guide.name: Anand Nair
guide.bio: Anand coordinates family retreats and honeymoon getaways across Kerala.

itinerary.title: Kochi Arrival & Drive to Munnar Tea Country
itinerary.offering: Pick up from Kochi. Scenic climb to Munnar hill station through valleys and waterfalls.
itinerary.insiderTip: Grab a hot cup of cardamom tea at the Valara falls viewpoint shop.

itinerary.title: Munnar Valleys & Tea Museum Heritage
itinerary.offering: Tour the heritage tea museum, stroll through scenic tea rows, and explore the wildlife park.
itinerary.insiderTip: The Tea Museum sells rare green tea varieties. Perfect for buying gifts.

itinerary.title: Alleppey Private Backwaters Houseboat Stay
itinerary.offering: Transfer to Alleppey. Board your wood-crafted private houseboat. Enjoy tropical backwater sailing with all meals prepared on-board.
itinerary.insiderTip: Sit on the open front deck during sunset; the reflections on the canal are gorgeous.

itinerary.title: Checkout & Kochi Transfer Out
itinerary.offering: Enjoy morning houseboat cruising, check out, and transfer to Kochi airport with shopping stops.
itinerary.insiderTip: Buy banana chips fried in coconut oil at local shops on the way to the airport.

packages.name: Kerala Highlights
packages.description: Comprehensive 6-day highlight tour of Kerala's tea estates and backwater houseboats.
highlights: Premium accommodations with breakfast included
Private AC SUV for transfers and tours
Guided spice plantation walk in Thekkady
Heritage tour of colonial Fort Kochi
exclusions: Flights or train tickets to Kochi
Entry tickets, safari tickets, and boating tickets
Lunch meals and dinner meals at hotels
Tips for driver and hotel workers
Personal shopping and laundry

faqs.q: What is included in the Kochi heritage tour?
faqs.a: We cover the Chinese Fishing Nets, Santa Cruz Cathedral Basilica, St. Francis Church, Jewish Town, and the Dutch Palace.

reviews.name: Pradeep Shenoy
reviews.comment: “The absolute best tour in Kerala. 6 days gave us enough time to relax and explore Munnar and the houseboats. Strongly recommend.”

guide.name: Anand Nair
guide.bio: Anand knows all the hidden viewpoints and tea-stalls in Munnar.

itinerary.title: Arrive in Kochi & Historic Fort Kochi Tour
itinerary.offering: Pick up from Kochi airport. Explore colonial Fort Kochi, check out the Dutch Palace, Jewish Synagogue, and view Chinese Fishing nets.
itinerary.insiderTip: Visit the small spice shops in Jewish town for high-quality spices.

itinerary.title: Drive to Munnar & Tea Estate Check-in
itinerary.offering: Drive up the winding Western Ghats through pine valleys. Check in to a premium tea estate resort.
itinerary.insiderTip: Munnar gets chilly at night. Bring a light pullover or shawl.

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing & Kundala Lake Boating
itinerary.offering: Visit Eravikulam to spot the Nilgiri Tahr. Enjoy pedal-boating on Kundala Lake and hear your voice echo at Echo Point.
itinerary.insiderTip: Row-boating at Kundala Lake during the afternoon is highly romantic.

itinerary.title: Travel to Thekkady & Wildlife Boat Cruise
itinerary.offering: Travel to Thekkady. Take a wildlife boat cruise on Periyar Lake and watch elephants bathing in the river.
itinerary.insiderTip: Stand on the upper deck of the Periyar boat for the best views of wild birds.

itinerary.title: Alleppey Private Backwaters Houseboat
itinerary.offering: Board your private luxury houseboat and cruise the tranquil backwaters of Vembanad Lake. Traditional Kerala lunch and dinner served on deck.
itinerary.insiderTip: The sunset over Vembanad Lake is truly spectacular. Keep your camera ready.

itinerary.title: Disembark & Transfer to Kochi Airport
itinerary.offering: Checkout from houseboat after breakfast and transfer to Kochi airport for departure flight.
itinerary.insiderTip: Get some fresh jackfruit chips packed to eat on the flight.

packages.name: Kerala Vibe Special
packages.description: Soak in southern vibes starting from Kovalam and Varkala beaches to the backwaters of Alleppey.
highlights: Beachfront resort stays in Kovalam & Varkala
Trivandrum heritage sightseeing tour
Alleppey backwaters day cruise with lunch
exclusions: Flights or train tickets to Trivandrum
Activity charges (scuba, surfing, temple entry)
Lunch and dinner meals at hotels
Tips for driver and local helpers
Personal items and drinks

faqs.q: Is temple entry included in Trivandrum?
faqs.a: We cover the vehicle transfers. Entry dress codes must be followed (sari/dhoti) for Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple.

reviews.name: Ramesh Krishnan
reviews.comment: “Amazing beaches! Varkala cliff resort views were beautiful and the Alleppey day cruise was peaceful. Great private sedan transfers.”

guide.name: Anand Nair
guide.bio: Anand is a seasoned Kerala travel coordinator.

itinerary.title: Trivandrum Arrival & Kovalam Beach Resort
itinerary.offering: Pick up from Trivandrum. Drive to Kovalam and check in to your premium beachfront resort. Spend the evening walking on the sandy beach.
itinerary.insiderTip: Walk to the red-and-white lighthouse at Kovalam beach for a stunning sunset view.

itinerary.title: Trivandrum Heritage Tour & Padmanabhaswamy Temple
itinerary.offering: Take a heritage tour of Trivandrum, visiting the famous Padmanabhaswamy Temple and Napier Museum.
itinerary.insiderTip: Traditional attire (dhoti for men, sari/salwar for women) is mandatory inside the Padmanabhaswamy temple.

itinerary.title: Drive to Varkala & Cliff Sunset Walks
itinerary.offering: Drive to Varkala. Check in to a resort on the edge of Varkala Cliff. Walk along the cliff overlooking the Arabian Sea and dine at local cafes.
itinerary.insiderTip: Dine at the Clafouti cafe on Varkala cliff for amazing wood-fired pizzas.

itinerary.title: Alleppey Backwaters Day Cruise & Canal Sailing
itinerary.offering: Drive to Alleppey. Board a houseboat for a private 5-hour day cruise with on-board lunch, sailing through palm-lined backwaters.
itinerary.insiderTip: Grab a fresh coconut directly from a lakeside stall while sailing.

itinerary.title: Departure drop at Trivandrum Airport
itinerary.offering: Checkout and drive back to Trivandrum airport/station for departure.
itinerary.insiderTip: Leave Alleppey early to avoid highway traffic near Kollam.

packages.name: Goa Beach Escape
packages.description: A curated getaway exploring heritage churches and the beautiful beaches of Goa.
highlights: Historical Latin Quarter (Fontainhas) guided walking tour
Scuba diving & snorkeling lesson at Grand Island
Lakeside sunset drinks & traditional Goan fish curry cooking class
exclusions: Flights or train tickets to Goa
Extra water sports charges not specified
Personal beverages and dinners
Tips for guides and boat operators
Laundry and camera entry fees

faqs.q: Is scuba diving safe for non-swimmers?
faqs.a: Yes, our certified PADI divers guide you individually in shallow waters with life jackets, making it completely safe for non-swimmers.

reviews.name: Karan Sharma
reviews.comment: “Goa was beautiful! The Fontainhas walking tour felt like being in Portugal. Loved Grand Island scuba diving.”

guide.name: Anand Nair
guide.bio: Anand knows all the beach side shacks and heritage spots across Goa.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Panaji & Fontainhas Heritage Walk
itinerary.offering: Pick up from Goa Airport. Check in to your heritage stay in Panaji. Join our evening guided walk through the colorful Portuguese houses of Fontainhas.
itinerary.insiderTip: Dine at Viva Panjim in Fontainhas for the most authentic pork vindaloo or fish recheado.

itinerary.title: Grand Island Scuba & Snorkeling Excursion
itinerary.offering: Early morning boat cruise to Grand Island. Enjoy underwater snorkeling, spotting dolphins, and a beginner-friendly guided scuba dive with certified coaches.
itinerary.insiderTip: Eat a very light breakfast before the boat ride as seas can get slightly choppy.

itinerary.title: North Goa Beaches & Fort Aguada
itinerary.offering: Check out and drive to Candolim. Visit the 17th-century Portuguese Fort Aguada lighthouse, and relax on the sands of Candolim beach.
itinerary.insiderTip: Walk to the lower fort walls of Aguada for direct, unobstructed views of the Arabian Sea.

itinerary.title: South Goa Escape & Palolem Beach Sunset
itinerary.offering: Drive down to South Goa's peaceful Palolem Beach. Stay in cozy beachfront wood cottages. Enjoy kayaking at sunset and a quiet beachside dinner.
itinerary.insiderTip: Rent a kayak and paddle out to the small Monkey Island just off the Palolem shore.

itinerary.title: Dudhsagar Waterfall Hike & Departure
itinerary.offering: Take a morning jungle jeep safari to the mighty Dudhsagar Waterfalls. Transfer to Goa Airport for your return flight.
itinerary.insiderTip: Dudhsagar pools are filled with fish; carry some biscuits to feed them.

packages.name: Rajasthan Royal Tour
packages.description: Experience majestic forts in Jaipur and Udaipur, and enjoy sunset desert camel safaris.
highlights: Private heritage palace stays & luxury desert glamping
Guided Amber Fort tour & camel sunset desert safari
Stargazing dinner over the Thar desert dunes with Rajasthani folk music
exclusions: Flights or train tickets to Jaipur
Monument entry tickets and guide fees
Lunch meals and personal drinks
Tips for drivers, safari staff, and camel handlers
Shopping or laundry expenses
packingList: Flat walking shoes for fort exploring

faqs.a: Yes, our luxury Jaisalmer glamping tents are equipped with modern air conditioning and attached concrete bathrooms.

reviews.name: Megha Singhal
reviews.comment: “Staying in real heritage palaces was amazing! The desert camp in Jaisalmer was the highlight—the stargazing dinner was magical.”

guide.name: Anand Nair
guide.bio: Anand leads historical and royal heritage tours across Rajasthan.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Jaipur & Chokhi Dhani Cultural Feast
itinerary.offering: Pick up and check in to your royal heritage hotel. Join our evening excursion to Chokhi Dhani for traditional folk dance and an authentic Rajasthani thali feast.
itinerary.insiderTip: Sit cross-legged for the traditional dining experience; the hosts will lovingly serve you multiple helpings of Dal Baati Churma.

itinerary.title: Amer Fort & Hawa Mahal Sightseeing
itinerary.offering: Guided exploration of Amer Fort, exploring the beautiful Sheesh Mahal (mirror hall). Stroll past Hawa Mahal and tour the City Palace museum.
itinerary.insiderTip: Visit Amer Fort early in the morning to beat the midday sun and enjoy clean photography lighting.

itinerary.title: Drive to Jodhpur & Mehrangarh Fort Walk
itinerary.offering: Drive to the blue city of Jodhpur. Tour the massive Mehrangarh Fort, which sits on a cliff overlooking the blue painted houses below.
itinerary.insiderTip: Visit Mehrangarh Fort’s museum; it has an incredible collection of royal palanquins and armory.

itinerary.title: Jodhpur Blue Streets & Bishnoi Village Safari
itinerary.offering: Walk through the blue alleys of old Jodhpur. Take a jeep safari to the Bishnoi villages to witness local wildlife and traditional clay pottery crafts.
itinerary.insiderTip: Dine at a rooftop restaurant near the Clock Tower for a stunning view of Mehrangarh lit up at night.

itinerary.title: Drive to Jaisalmer & Thar Desert Camp Check-in
itinerary.offering: Drive across the desert to Jaisalmer. Check in to your luxury air-conditioned desert camp. Enjoy sunset camel rides on the sand dunes.
itinerary.insiderTip: Hold on tight to the saddle when the camel rises; they stand up back-legs first.

itinerary.title: Golden Fort & Havelis of Jaisalmer
itinerary.offering: Tour the living Jaisalmer Fort where local families still reside. Explore the intricate yellow-stone carvings at Patwon ki Haveli.
itinerary.insiderTip: Buy authentic desert handloom blankets made from local camel wool inside the fort shops.

itinerary.title: Desert Dune Bashing & Stargazing Dinner
itinerary.offering: Thrill yourself with 4x4 dune bashing over the sand dunes. Relish a traditional stargazing campfire dinner with live folk musicians.
itinerary.insiderTip: Desert skies are extremely clear; bring a tripod to capture long-exposure photos of the Milky Way.

itinerary.title: Departure Drop at Jodhpur Airport
itinerary.offering: Drive back to Jodhpur airport/station for departure, loaded with golden memories of Rajasthan.
itinerary.insiderTip: Stop at Pokhran on the highway for a quick tea and local clay craft display.

packages.name: Manali Valley Trek
packages.description: Escape to snowy peaks. Hike scenic mountain trails and enjoy paragliding in Solang Valley.
highlights: Riverside cottage stays with snowy balcony views
Paragliding at Solang Valley & Rohtang Pass excursion
Guided cedar forest trek and hot sulfur spring bath in Vashisht
exclusions: Flights or train to Delhi/Chandigarh
Adventure sport gear hire or licenses
Dinner and lunch meals
Tips for mountain guides and drivers
Optional Rohtang Pass vehicle upgrades
packingList: Fleece jacket and warm windproof layer
Hiking shoes with thick rubber sole

faqs.a: We provide transport and safety coordinator. Paragliding flight cost is paid directly to certified local pilots.

reviews.name: Varun Joshi
reviews.comment: “Loved the Solang trek! Balcony view from our Manali resort was lovely. Perfect group trip layout.”

guide.name: Vikram Aditya
guide.bio: Vikram guides high-altitude Himalayan treks across Himachal and Kashmir.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Shimla Volvo Drive
itinerary.offering: Board your premium overnight Volvo bus from Delhi. Climb through beautiful pine forests and check in to your heritage hotel in Shimla.
itinerary.insiderTip: Pick a window seat on the left side of the Volvo for the best sunrise views as the bus enters the hills.

itinerary.title: Shimla Ridge & Kufri Snow View
itinerary.offering: Drive to Kufri for breathtaking snowy mountain views. Hike up to the historic Jakhoo temple and walk along Shimla Ridge mall road.
itinerary.insiderTip: Keep all snacks and items zipped inside your bag; the monkeys at Jakhoo temple are very clever at grabbing things.

itinerary.title: Scenic Drive to Manali & River Valley Stay
itinerary.offering: Drive from Shimla to Manali, passing through Kullu valley alongside the Beas River. Check in to your riverview resort.
itinerary.insiderTip: Stop at the Kullu handloom cooperative to buy authentic wool shawls and caps.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley Paragliding & Adventure
itinerary.offering: Spend the day at Solang Valley. Enjoy thrilling adventure activities like paragliding, zorbing, and hike to the hidden Anjani Mahadev waterfall.
itinerary.insiderTip: Opt for the long paragliding flight from the top cable car station for the ultimate thrill.

itinerary.title: Jogini Waterfall Trek & Vashisht Hot Springs
itinerary.offering: Take a guided nature trek through cedar woods to the scenic Jogini Waterfalls. Soak in the therapeutic hot sulfur baths at Vashisht Temple.
itinerary.insiderTip: Dine at the Lazy Dog cafe in Old Manali; they have great live music and food.

itinerary.title: Manali Mall Road & Volvo Return to Delhi
itinerary.offering: Visit the historic Hadimba Temple. Do souvenir shopping at Mall Road, before boarding the overnight Volvo bus back to Delhi.
itinerary.insiderTip: Arrive at the Volvo stand early; evening departures are busy.

packages.name: Andaman Island Getaway
packages.route: Port Blair (1N) → Havelock Island (3N) → Neil Island (1N)
packages.description: Swim in turquoise waters of Radhanagar Beach and snorkel at Elephant Beach.
highlights: Premium beachfront villa stay with private deck access
Snorkeling at Elephant Beach & scuba dive lesson in Havelock
Private cruise ferry transfers between islands
exclusions: Flights to and from Port Blair
Extra water sports and boat rentals
Lunch meals and personal drinks
Tips for boat crew and resort staff
Camera entry tickets at Cellular Jail

faqs.q: Are cruise transfers confirmed in advance?
faqs.a: Yes, all inter-island transfers (Port Blair to Havelock and Neil) are pre-booked in luxury AC cruises like Makruzz or Nautika.

reviews.name: Sneha Reddy
reviews.comment: “Incredible experience! The Radhanagar beach was so clean and the snorkeling was unforgettable. Cruise transfers were smooth.”

guide.name: Anand Nair
guide.bio: Anand guides tropical and beach side getaways across Kerala and Andaman.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Port Blair & Cellular Jail Light Show
itinerary.offering: Pick up from Port Blair airport. Check in to your premium hotel. Visit the historic Cellular Jail museum and watch the evening light and sound show.
activities: Cellular Jail entry tickets & light show
itinerary.insiderTip: Sit in the center seats of the gallery for the best sound dispersion during the light show.

itinerary.title: Private Cruise to Havelock Island & Radhanagar Beach
itinerary.offering: Board your private luxury AC cruise ferry to Havelock Island. Check in to your beachfront resort. Spend the afternoon lounging on the famous white sands of Radhanagar Beach.
itinerary.insiderTip: Radhanagar beach is rated one of the cleanest in Asia. Keep food items sealed in bags; crabs are active.

itinerary.title: Elephant Beach Snorkeling & Water Sports
itinerary.offering: Take a speedboat to Elephant Beach. Enjoy a complimentary snorkeling session, exploring vibrant shallow coral reefs and marine life with certified guides.
itinerary.insiderTip: Wear water shoes or sandals; the entry reef can have sharp shells.

itinerary.title: Cruise to Neil Island & Natural Bridge sunset
itinerary.offering: Cruise to Neil Island, the quiet eco-haven. Check in to your beach resort. Tour the unique Natural Coral Bridge formations during low tide.
itinerary.insiderTip: The bridge path is rocky; watch your footing and wear good grip shoes.

itinerary.title: Return Cruise to Port Blair
itinerary.offering: Cruise back to Port Blair. Enjoy local shopping at Sagarika emporium and visit the Samudrika Marine Museum.
itinerary.insiderTip: Buy authentic coconut-shell items and pearl jewelry at Sagarika govt emporium.

itinerary.title: Airport Drop & Departure
itinerary.offering: Checkout and transfer to Port Blair airport for your flight back home, carrying tropical island vibes in your soul.
itinerary.insiderTip: Pack shells in check-in bags; airport security confiscates shells found in cabin bags.
